title: pvDateToNumeric
body:
## pvDateToNumeric

Finds string arrays holding dates (point, cell, field or table row data) and adds a numeric copy of each as <name>_numeric, in seconds since the Unix epoch, so dates can be plotted, thresholded or used in calculators. VTK tries DateFormat first, then built-in fallback formats; the format is chosen from the first value, and an array whose first value does not parse is skipped. Typical input is a CSV table read with a CSV reader.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Dates are interpreted in the local time zone of the machine running ParaView (std::mktime), so results shift between machines; store UTC times and compare on one machine.
- Values that do not match the chosen format become 0.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `DateToNumeric`. Identity: `filters/DateToNumeric`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
